::: {.researchcontainer .lead-card}
As an open-source GIS enthusiast, I thought it would be fun to create an interactive map of all the places I have conducted research, as well as all of the places I have been fortunate enough to travel to for conferences, workshops, and colloquia. Use the buttons on the left to jump between regions, and click a field site to read about the project behind it.

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)

# -------------------------
# Helpers
# -------------------------
# Popup card: optional photo, title, description, optional link to the Research page
popup_card <- function(title, desc, img = NA, link = NA) {
  paste0(
    "<div class='map-pop'>",
    ifelse(is.na(img), "", paste0("<img src='", img, "' alt=''>")),
    "<div class='map-pop-title'>", title, "</div>",
    "<div class='map-pop-desc'>", desc, "</div>",
    ifelse(is.na(link), "",
           paste0("<a class='map-pop-link' href='", link, "'>Read about this project &rarr;</a>")),
    "</div>"
  )
}

# -------------------------
# Data
# -------------------------
sites <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name, ~desc, ~lng, ~lat, ~img, ~link,
  "Merced Vernal Pools and Grassland Reserve",
    "Drone LiDAR and plant surveys of vernal pool hydrology and species richness (Dissertation Ch. 1).",
    -120.405, 37.395, "imgs/web/vernal_pool.jpg", "projects.html#vernal-pools",
  "Grayson Riverbend Preserve",
    "eDNA and water-quality sampling on the San Joaquin River floodplain (Dissertation Ch. 2).",
    -121.175705, 37.573927, "imgs/web/jn_sampling.jpg", "projects.html#floodplains",
  "Cosumnes River Preserve",
    "Floodplain field site, Cosumnes River, CA.",
    -121.440734, 38.265969, NA, NA,
  "Russian River Watershed",
    "Mediterranean-climate watershed, Sonoma and Mendocino Counties, CA.",
    -123.006, 38.508, NA, NA,
  "Berg River Watershed",
    "NASA BioSCape biodiversity sampling, Greater Cape Floristic Region, South Africa.",
    19.050, -33.905, "imgs/web/berg_macroinverts.jpg", "projects.html#bioscape",
  "Eerste River Watershed",
    "NASA BioSCape sampling and OpenRES river classification (Dissertation Ch. 3).",
    18.946042, -33.977875, "imgs/web/eerste.jpg", "projects.html#openres"
) %>%
  mutate(popup = popup_card(name, desc, img, link), radius = 8)

confs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name, ~popup, ~lng, ~lat, ~year,
  "Washington, D.C. (AGU24)", "AGU24 — Washington, D.C. (Oral)", -77.0369, 38.9072, 2024,
  "Davis, CA", "Labor and Automation in California Agriculture Annual Meeting — UC Davis (Poster)", -121.7405, 38.5449, 2024,
  "Long Beach, CA (ESA)", "ESA Annual Meeting — Long Beach, CA (Poster)", -118.1937, 33.7701, 2024,
  "College Park, MD", "NASA CCE Joint Science Workshop — University of Maryland (Poster)", -76.9378, 38.9897, 2023,
  "Chicago, IL", "AGU Fall Meeting 2022 — Chicago, IL (Poster)", -87.6298, 41.8781, 2022,
  "Montreal, QC", "ESA Annual Meeting 2022 — Montreal, QC", -73.5673, 45.5019, 2022,
  "Fresno, CA", "FIRA 2022 — Fresno, CA (Poster)", -119.7871, 36.7378, 2022,
  "West Lafayette, IN", "IoT for Precision Agriculture Annual Meeting — Purdue University, West Lafayette, IN", -86.9081, 40.4259, 2022,
  "San Francisco, CA", "AGU Annual Symposium 2020 — San Francisco, CA (Poster)", -122.4194, 37.7749, 2020,
  "Philadelphia, PA", "IoT4Ag Annual Meeting 2025 — Philadelphia, PA", -75.1652, 39.9526, 2025,
  "Brisbane, AU", "IGARSS 2025 — Brisbane, Australia", 153.0251, -27.4698, 2025,
  "Houw Hoek, ZA", "NASA BioSCape Joint Science Workshop 2023 — Houw Hoek, South Africa", 19.1509, -34.2052, 2023
) %>%
  mutate(
    popup = popup_card(name, popup),
    radius = case_when(year >= 2025 ~ 7, year == 2024 ~ 6, year == 2023 ~ 5.5, TRUE ~ 5)
  )

inst <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name, ~desc, ~lng, ~lat,
  "UC Santa Cruz", "University of California, Santa Cruz — Visiting Scientist", -122.0609, 36.9914,
  "UC Merced", "University of California, Merced — Ph.D., Environmental Systems", -120.4319402, 37.3633252
) %>%
  mutate(popup = popup_card(name, desc), radius = 8)

# -------------------------
# Watershed outlines
# Delineated from each river's outlet with the Global Watersheds API
# (mghydro.com, MERIT-Hydro). Downloaded once at render time and cached in
# data/watersheds/. Delete a file there to re-download it.
# -------------------------
ws_dir <- "data/watersheds"
dir.create(ws_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

watersheds <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name, ~file, ~outlet_lat, ~outlet_lng,
  "Russian River Watershed", "russian_river.geojson", 38.4535, -123.1170,
  "Berg River Watershed",    "berg_river.geojson",   -32.7900,  18.1800,
  "Eerste River Watershed",  "eerste_river.geojson", -34.0700,  18.7600
)

read_watershed <- function(name, file, outlet_lat, outlet_lng) {
  path <- file.path(ws_dir, file)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    url <- sprintf(
      "https://mghydro.com/app/watershed_api?lat=%s&lng=%s&precision=low&simplify=true",
      outlet_lat, outlet_lng
    )
    try(download.file(url, path, quiet = TRUE, mode = "wb"), silent = TRUE)
  }
  if (!file.exists(path) || file.size(path) < 200) return(NULL)
  gj <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(path, simplifyVector = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(gj) || length(gj$features) == 0) return(NULL)
  area <- gj$features[[1]]$properties$area_km2
  for (i in seq_along(gj$features)) {
    gj$features[[i]]$properties$popup <- popup_card(
      name,
      paste0("Watershed outline", if (!is.null(area)) paste0(" · ~", area, " km²") else "",
             ". Delineated with the Global Watersheds API (MERIT-Hydro).")
    )
  }
  gj
}

# -------------------------
# Styling
# -------------------------
site_hex <- "#e2b553"
conf_hex <- "#c98bd9"
inst_hex <- "#6cc3b4"
ws_hex   <- "#7fb8e0"

# Region buttons
fly_btn <- function(label, title, js) {
  easyButton(icon = paste0("<span class='map-btn'>", label, "</span>"),
             title = title, onClick = JS(paste0("function(btn, map){ ", js, " }")))
}

# -------------------------
# Map
# -------------------------
m <- leaflet(width = "100%", height = 640,
             options = leafletOptions(worldCopyJump = TRUE, minZoom = 2)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Esri World Imagery") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap,  group = "Esri World Topo") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$OpenTopoMap,        group = "Open Topography") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron,   group = "CartoDB Positron") %>%
  addProviderTiles(
    providers$Esri.WorldShadedRelief, group = "Hillshade",
    options = providerTileOptions(opacity = 0.55)
  ) %>%
  setView(lng = -20, lat = 15, zoom = 2)

# Watershed polygons (drawn first so markers sit on top)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(watersheds))) {
  gj <- with(watersheds[i, ], read_watershed(name, file, outlet_lat, outlet_lng))
  if (!is.null(gj)) {
    m <- m %>% addGeoJSON(gj, group = "Watersheds", color = ws_hex, weight = 1.5,
                          opacity = 0.9, fillColor = ws_hex, fillOpacity = 0.12)
  }
}

m <- m %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = sites, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, popup = ~popup, label = ~name,
    radius = ~radius, stroke = TRUE, color = "#0d1714", weight = 1.5,
    fillColor = site_hex, fillOpacity = 0.95, group = "Research Sites"
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = confs, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, popup = ~popup, label = ~name,
    radius = ~radius, stroke = TRUE, color = "#0d1714", weight = 1.5,
    fillColor = conf_hex, fillOpacity = 0.9, group = "Conference Travel"
  ) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = inst, lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat, popup = ~popup, label = ~name,
    radius = ~radius, stroke = TRUE, color = "#0d1714", weight = 1.5,
    fillColor = inst_hex, fillOpacity = 0.95, group = "Institutions"
  ) %>%
  addEasyButtonBar(
    fly_btn("World", "Show everything", "map.flyTo([15, -20], 2);"),
    fly_btn("CA", "California field sites",
            "map.flyToBounds([[36.7, -123.7], [39.5, -119.9]]);"),
    fly_btn("W. Cape", "Western Cape, South Africa",
            "map.flyToBounds([[-34.4, 17.9], [-32.6, 19.6]]);")
  ) %>%
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c(
      "Esri World Imagery",
      "Esri World Topo",
      "Open Topography",
      "CartoDB Positron"
    ),
    overlayGroups = c("Hillshade", "Watersheds", "Research Sites",
                      "Conference Travel", "Institutions"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  addMiniMap(toggleDisplay = TRUE) %>%
  addScaleBar(position = "bottomleft") %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    colors = c(site_hex, conf_hex, inst_hex, ws_hex),
    labels = c("Research sites", "Conference travel", "Institutions", "Watersheds"),
    opacity = 1
  )

m
```
:::
